Conclusion:
  F(T0) > N0 + 2 by more than 8.0234. Since F is strictly increasing for
  T > 2*pi, the Bellotti--Wong global upper envelope cannot certify any
  strict verified-height extension above T0 by the one-new-zero budget. Any
  replacement global envelope of the same form would need an error term below
  3.775672128481674 at T0; Bellotti--Wong's error is above 11.799073709103090.
